intake.title: Patient information
intake.subtitle: Before Kai asks about your symptoms, we need a few details for your doctor's report.
intake.primaryLanguageHelper: Auto-detected from your app settings — confirm or edit
intake.lifestyleHelper: Tap any that apply — this goes to your doctor's report.
intake.consent: I agree to Keiro's {terms} and {privacy}, including the collection and processing of my health information to generate medical reports.
intake.errDobInvalid: Enter a valid date of birth
intake.errDobTooYoung: You must be at least {age} years old to use Keiro.
intake.errSubmit: Something went wrong saving your profile. Please try again.
auth.title: Ready when you are
auth.subtitle: Tap start and I'll walk you through everything, one step at a time.
auth.privacy: No account, no email, no password. What you tell me stays private, and is only used to write the report you show your doctor.
auth.legal: By continuing you agree to our {terms} and {privacy}
confirm.pitch: Tell me how you're feeling in your language. I may ask a few simple questions, then I'll create an English summary you can show your healthcare provider.
confirm.romanDescription: Show Kai's messages using English letters instead of this script.
confirm.openChatIn: We'll open your chat in {language}, so you can tell me what's wrong in your own words. You can change this anytime.
chat.sessionExpiring: Your session will expire soon. Prepare your report before it ends.
chat.errRateLimit: You're sending messages too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
chat.errChat: Something went wrong reaching Kai. Please try again.
chat.errReport: We couldn't prepare your report. Please try again.
chat.reportReady: Your report is ready. Open it again any time.
chat.audioPlaying: Kai is reading the message aloud
chat.audioBlocked: Your browser held the audio back. Tap Try again to hear it.
chat.audioFailed: Kai's voice couldn't load. Check your connection, then tap Try again.
chat.audioUnavailable: This device can't play Kai's voice right now. The message is written above.
chat.endBody: Your answers will be cleared from this phone. You can start again any time.
chat.hintSpeak: Tap the microphone and speak — or type your answer.
report.shareNote: Anyone with this link and access can open the report.
mic.error.denied: Microphone access is turned off for Keiro. You can type your message instead — it works exactly the same.
mic.error.noHardware: No microphone was found on this device. Please type your message instead.
mic.error.inUse: Your microphone is busy in another app or browser tab. Close it and try again — or type your message instead.
mic.error.insecure: Voice input needs a secure connection on this device. Please type your message instead.
mic.error.unsupported: This browser does not support voice input. Please type your message instead, or open Keiro in Safari or Chrome.
mic.error.unknown: Voice input could not start on this device. Please type your message instead.
mic.requesting: Allow the microphone if your phone asks
mic.inApp.banner: Voice input does not work inside {app}. Tap the ⋯ or ⋮ menu at the top and choose “Open in browser”. You can still type your message below.
mic.help.title: Turn on your microphone
mic.help.intro: Keiro needs your permission to use the microphone. Follow the steps for the app you are using:
mic.help.iosStep1: Open the Settings app on your phone.
mic.help.iosStep4: Find Keiro in the list and tap Allow.
mic.help.iosStep5: Come back to this page and tap Try again.
mic.help.androidStep1: Tap the lock icon next to the web address at the top of the screen.
mic.help.androidStep5: Come back to this page and tap Try again.
mic.help.otherStep1: Find the lock or information icon next to the web address.
mic.help.otherStep4: Come back to this page and tap Try again.
mic.help.fixed: Your microphone is on. You can tap the microphone button now.
mic.help.stillBlocked: The microphone is still turned off. Please check the steps above — or type your message instead.
mic.help.typeInstead: You can always type instead. The message box works the same way.
report.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — press and hold the link to copy it.
mic.voice.failed: Voice input didn't work this time. You can type your message instead.
mic.voice.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before trying voice again, or type your message instead.
mic.voice.noSpeech: No speech was heard. Please try again, or type your message instead.
mic.voice.interrupted: Voice input could not finish. Please try again, or type your message instead.
mic.voice.startFailed: Voice input could not start. Please try again, or type your message instead.
site.hero.title: Speak in your language and help your doctor understand.
site.hero.body: Tell Kai how you're feeling in your own language. Kai may ask a few simple questions, then creates a clear English summary you can show your healthcare provider. Keiro is free and does not diagnose or give medical advice.
site.steps.title: How Keiro works
site.steps.1.title: Choose your language
site.steps.1.body: Select the language you're most comfortable speaking.
site.steps.2.title: Speak or type
site.steps.2.body: Tell Kai how you're feeling using your own words.
site.steps.3.title: Answer a few questions
site.steps.3.body: Kai may ask simple questions to make your summary clear.
site.steps.4.title: Show the summary
site.steps.4.body: Keiro creates an English summary you can show your healthcare provider.
site.languages.title: Keiro supports 45 languages
site.languages.body: Choose one above to read this page in your language, or see the full list.
site.trust.title: Kai helps you explain, and your provider decides what care you need.
site.trust.1.title: No diagnosis or treatment advice
site.trust.1.body: Kai helps you describe your symptoms. Your healthcare provider decides what they mean.
site.trust.2.title: Free to use
site.trust.2.body: You can start without creating an account.
site.trust.3.title: You can stop anytime
site.trust.3.body: End the conversation whenever you want.
site.trust.emergency: If this is an emergency, call your local emergency number.
site.final.title: Ready to tell Kai how you're feeling?
site.footer.description: Keiro helps you explain how you feel in your language and creates an English summary for your healthcare provider.
site.footer.safety: Kai is not a doctor and does not diagnose. If this is an emergency, call your local emergency number now.
site.footer.built: Made for patients who need to be understood.
site.how.intro: Speak or type in your language. Kai may ask a few questions, then gives you an English summary to show your healthcare provider.
site.how.note: You can read the summary before showing it to anyone. Kai does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
site.languages.intro: Choose a language to read about Keiro in that language. You can decide when to start Kai.
site.onboarding.tap: Select a language to learn what happens next.
site.cookie.title: Cookie choices
site.cookie.body: We use anonymous usage statistics to improve Keiro. We never include your health information.
